decision_cruda.rationale: LH-02 repair estimate is 09:45-10:00 (likely 09:54), in place. N600-08 holds 171 t (~63 oz). After repair LH-02 loads it at 33 t/h in about 5.2 h, which is done by about 15:15, before 17:00. A short delay therefore costs no ounces. A loan from a Norte heading would cost development value and arrive about when the repair finishes. Radio and CMMS agree, so there is no conflict. No move is made.

LH-02 is down at N600-08 until at least 14:30, likely 15:30, and the radio and CMMS agree. The stope has 171 t at 11.5 g/t, about 63 oz. LH-08 comes from the infrastructure heading, which costs only 0.5 oz/h, and is 0.34 h away. It loads 23.6 t/h, so the 171 t takes about 7.2 h, or about 3.6 oz of heading value lost. Norte inflow rises from 42 to about 66 t/h, which just fits the 66 t/h truck capacity. Net gain is about 55 oz. I left the LH-09 heading alone (2 oz/h) and LH-10 is in PM until 14:00. No reserve is activated because no stope was stopped.
